title: Woman in Winter Coat & Headscarf, 1947 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot photograph taken on February 23, 1947, depicting a smiling young woman standing outside a clapboard house. She is dressed in late 1940s post-WWII fashion, wearing a belted dark trench overcoat, light gloves, heels, and a patterned headscarf tied around her hair. Sharp sunlight casts distinct shadows against the siding of the home behind her.
